content.comment_body: Hello, My issue is that everything is functioning correctly with the [product_name] communication and web page, but only from the programming PC on the local network. When using another PC or tablet on the same network, no communication is possible. Kind regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum; kindly write your future posts in English. Thank you.
Are you connecting from the same local network when experiencing this issue?

Hello, I apologize for my basic English. Please be understanding. My problem is that everything works with the [product_name]—communication through the network port and the web page—but only with the programming PC over Ethernet. When another PC or tablet is connected via Ethernet, there is no communication possible. Wishing everyone a great day.
Hello, Yes, the network setup is identical; only the device (PC, tablet, or smartphone) changes. Apologies for my English. Thanks a lot.

Hi, Please ensure that only one device is connected to the web server at a time. If your PC already has the web page open, other devices may be unable to connect and view the web page. Hope this helps.

Hello, The issue appears to be that my PC has an IP address compatible with both the router and the [product_name] simultaneously. By configuring a new IP address on the [product_name], everything works fine. I am new to this. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have difficulties accessing the web server of the [product_name] device from multiple devices on the same local network. Communication works only with the programming PC, while other devices (PCs, tablets, smartphones) are unable to access the web page. This points to confusion around network configuration or restrictions on multiple simultaneous connections. The main cause identified is related to IP addressing and device compatibility within the local network.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to access the [product_name] web server from any device on the same local network, not limited to just the programming PC.
